notes.title: Interceptor – Development Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41179976/532922b3a0d7ee0c9641f0a24c49d652be5c45a0.jpg"]

We truly appreciate your interest and all the wishlists - it's a real boost for our team. We're moving development forward, adopting new technologies, and growing our studio to make Interceptor the best it can be.



In a few days, we'll be sharing our roadmap with more details about what's ahead.



Thanks for following our journey!
